text:
meera: security-alert-bot flagged a public listing on gs://redwood-models-prod. audit logs show object.list by external IP 34.123.45.67. bucket appears to contain model checkpoints and inference assets. CMEK bindings missing on the bucket. need quick containment and comms.

sec-bot: [Automated detection] gcs.object.list on gs://redwood-models-prod detected at 2026-03-20T10:02:14Z from ip=34.123.45.67. detection_id=det-20260320-1189. elevated risk: publicListing=true, uniformBucketLevelAccess=false

chris: OK prioritizing. who can run immediate containment? we should avoid deleting objects. quick wins: remove allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers IAM, enable uniform bucket-level access, set default ACLs to private, add audit sink.

meera: @chris please run the gsutil commands below. I'll own comms and legal notification. do NOT rotate or delete keys until we snapshot logs.

meera: ```
# remove public ACLs
gsutil iam ch -d allUsers:objectViewer gs://redwood-models-prod
gsutil iam ch -d allAuthenticatedUsers:objectViewer gs://redwood-models-prod
# enforce uniform bucket level access
gsutil uniformbucketlevelaccess set on gs://redwood-models-prod
# make bucket private (double-check bindings)
gsutil iam get gs://redwood-models-prod > /tmp/iam.json
# review and then set
gsutil iam set /tmp/iam.json gs://redwood-models-prod
```

jamal: also add a BQ audit sink and export object access logs. we need the full timeline before any key rotation. recommend creating a near-term retention copy of logs to a separate project.

meera: filing incident ticket INC-3456 and paging on-call. tagging legal: @sarah-legal. we should prepare a short timeline and customer impact statement.

sarah-legal: don't delete or modify object contents. preserve forensic integrity. collect IAM policy, object metadata, audit log exports, and storage access logs. prepare notice draft if customer data is affected.

chris: ran the remove-public ACL commands and turned uniform bucket-level access on. confirmation: gsutil iam get shows no allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers bindings. gsutil ls -L gs://redwood-models-prod | grep "ACL" shows uniform access enabled.

sec-bot: [Update] detection status: containment=partial (public listing disabled), recommended next steps: rotate any service account keys that had access, create KMS key policy that denies external use, run IAM Recommender checks.

jamal: we have two service accounts with storage.admin in the bucket project: infra-deploy-sa and infer-serving-sa. recommended: remove broad roles, switch to least-privilege (storage.objectViewer on specific prefixes). I'll open a PR to patch IAM and add a temporary deny rule for external IP ranges.

meera: action items: 1) jamal to create PR restricting SA permissions and add deny rule — due 2026-03-20 16:00 UTC; 2) chris to enable audit sink to bigquery and export logs — done/verify; 3) security to snapshot current logs & metadata — meera assigned; 4) legal to draft customer comms if required — sarah assigned.

chris: enabled sink: created bigquery dataset redwood_incident_3456 and sink redwood_gcs_sink. pushing logs now. verified first rows in table.

meera: please do not rotate KMS key until we capture usage. instead: create a new CMK, limit principal bindings, and plan rotation after forensic review. we should also schedule a Key Access Review meeting.

jamal: PR opened: infra#412 restricts infer-serving-sa to storage.objectViewer on gs://redwood-models-prod/inference/* and removes project-level storage.admin. requesting review @chris. also adding terraform guard to block public_read_predefined_acl on storage_bucket resource.

sarah-legal: confirm we have retained audit logs for 90 days and have exported them. also confirm list of customers whose artifacts are in that bucket so we can assess notification scope.

meera: logs retained to bq (dataset/redwood_incident_3456), object list exported to snapshot gs://redwood-forensics-snapshots/2100001234/ (read-only). started mapping objects to customer ids.

chris: ran iam policy analyzer against bucket — found two legacy bindings; removed them. also updated org policy to disable legacy ACLs for GCS across the org (policy applied to billing account). propagation may take up to 5 minutes.

sec-bot: detection closed (containment confirmed). incident severity downgraded to P2 pending post-incident review. forensic artifacts archived.

meera: post-incident actions: - complete RBAC audit across all model buckets (owner: jamal, due 2026-03-27) - add Terraform policy guard to prevent public ACLs (owner: jamal, merged) - automate alerting for object.list from external IP ranges (owner: chris, due 2026-03-24) - schedule KMS key access review and rotation plan (owner: meera, due 2026-03-25) - update runbook with containment commands and legal checklist (owner: meera, due 2026-03-22)

jamal: will also add unit tests in infra CI to fail on tf that sets public_predefined_acl or enables uniformBucketLevelAccess=false.

meera: thanks everyone. can we have a 30m postmortem tomorrow 2026-03-21 09:00 UTC to capture timeline and writeup? invite: #eng, #product-security, #legal.

chris: ack, calendar invite sent.

sarah-legal: ack — prepping statement template.

meera: closing thread for live containment. will update INC-3456 with final timeline and link to this thread.
